notes.title: The New Server Empire Expedition starts at 10:00 am on November 18th
notes.content:
The maritime dispute led to the official launch of the New Taiwan Empire Expedition at 10 am on November 18th.
Service opening activities
Sign in and give gifts to help set sail
On the first day of check-in, purple navigators will be sent, on the next day, orange navigators will be sent, and on the seventh day, orange outfits will be sent to help navigators overcome the early stages of server opening
Explore commercial routes and strive to become a wealthy sailor
Unlock various port specialties in the game and explore popular product routes. Sailors who run the top 10 stores 7 days before the server opens at 21:00 in the evening will receive additional rewards
Brave and bloody battle, who can be the king of glory
Sailors who have battled for the top 10 of the bloodbath push chart 7 days before the server launch will receive additional rewards at 21:00 in the evening
Weekend revelry and enjoy fishing fun
From 12:30 to 13:30 on weekends, you can fish for free and unlimited at the four major fishing grounds in the game, with experience, equipment, and coins rolling in
Pirates attack, players join forces to challenge
At 21:30 on the weekend evening, the pirate leader will be refreshed on the activity map, with strong strength and the need for various navigators to work together to fight
For more exciting activities, please log in to the game and experience it. Let's set sail together and embark on a voyage!

notes.title: 霸者之证 I 通关攻略
notes.content:
大家好呀！

《航海纷争》已经上线1个月了，想必大家对游戏已经有了一定程度的了解。最近经常有玩家找客服同学要通关秘籍，那么我就勉为其难的教教大家一些小技巧吧~（手动狗头）

[h1][b]通关奖励：[/b]血量+5000[/h1]
[h2][b]怪物介绍：[/b][/h2]
[b]霸者*爱德华：[/b]无特殊技能，单纯攻击和血量比副首高一点。
[b]帮凶：[/b]有回血和无敌技能。
[b]副手：[/b]只有一个无敌技能。
[h2][b]技能介绍：[/b][/h2]
入场后，“副手”会优先使用无敌技能，10秒无敌后，“帮凶”会使用无敌技能，持续10秒无敌，两次无敌后，场上怪物回复全部血量，再开始新一轮的无敌---无敌---回血。
[h2][b]策略：[/b][/h2]
只要输出达到斩杀线，10秒内可以击败任一“副首”或“帮凶”，就可以轻松过。
[h2][b]打法：[/b][/h2]
旗帜推荐3面火炎爆，技能换火力压制，首相推荐龙象增伤、玄武像减伤、恶魔像吸血。开局移动到“副手”上方，等“副手”无敌技能结束后，所有技能交给“副手”，把“副手”秒了后，等“帮凶”使用回血技能。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272674/753fc7cd762dd3aad45551d009856c39aed24aad.png[/img]
等回血技能放完，就围着“帮凶”，和打“副首”一样的方法，把所有技能交给“帮凶”，秒掉“副手”后，照常打“霸者*爱德华”就可轻松通过霸证1。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272674/a8e5a8ff2a375f6e19012e5d0181071470a060e9.png[/img]

“霸者之证 I ”通关攻略就介绍到这里啦，下次小编会带来“霸者之证 II”的通关攻略以及其他有用姿势（手动滑稽），下次见啦~
